exercises.title: Construct the induced topology
exercises.objective: Use the inclusion from a subtype into the ambient space.

exercises.title: Characterise subspace opens
exercises.objective: Express every relative open as an ambient open preimage.
success: subspace opens are ambient open preimages

exercises.title: Exhibit open but not closed
exercises.objective: Use singleton true and its non-open Boolean complement in Sierpiński space.
success: open not closed example is singleton true

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : TopologicalSpace α) (A : Set α) (s : Set A) (h : T10.SubspaceOpen τ A s) : ∃ U : Set α, @IsOpen α τ U ∧ s = (fun x : A => x.1) ⁻¹' U := h
checks.message: A predicate for relative opens must return an ambient open preimage, not merely say the direct image is open.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : TopologicalSpace α) (A : Set α) : @Continuous A α (T10.subspaceTopology τ A) τ (fun x : A => x.1) := continuous_induced_dom
checks.message: The subtype inclusion must be continuous for the topology you constructed.

checks.lean: example : LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski.IsOpen T10.openNotClosedSet := by simpa [T10.openNotClosedSet, LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski, LeanCraftGame.Topology.particularPoint]
checks.message: `openNotClosedSet` must actually be open in Sierpiński space.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski.IsOpen T10.openNotClosedSetᶜ := by
  have ht : T10.openNotClosedSet = {true} := by ext b; simp [T10.openNotClosedSet]
  rw [ht]
  have hc : ({true} : Set Bool)ᶜ = {false} := by ext b; cases b <;> simp
  rw [hc]
  simp [LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski, LeanCraftGame.Topology.particularPoint]
checks.message: The example's complement must not be open; singleton true is open but not closed.

hints.hint: Return `∃ U : Set α, @IsOpen α τ U ∧ s = (fun x : A => x.1) ⁻¹' U`.
